articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, announced the winners of the 2026 DakClassroom Student Showcase, a national competition recognizing outstanding student achievement in media production, storytelling and live event operations.
articles.title: DakClassroom Student Showcase Celebrates Student Creativity and Career-Ready Skills in Live Event Production

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, announced the availability of see‑through LED window displays for retail stores, convenience stores, gas stations, quick‑serve restaurants and shopping center environments, expanding the company’s on‑premise digital signage portfolio.
articles.title: Daktronics Expands On-Premise Digital Signage with See-Through LED Window Display

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, partnered with Morlin Asset Management to deliver a large-scale LED video display at Los Angeles Union Station, one of the busiest transportation hubs in the United States, ahead of a high-profile sporting event held near the station.
articles.title: Daktronics Installs 100-Foot-Wide LED Display at Los Angeles Union Station

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, announced the launch of LiveWrx, a fan engagement platform designed for high schools to create interactive experiences at live sporting events using their video boards.
articles.title: Daktronics Introduces LiveWrx Fan Engagement Platform for High School Sports

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, was selected by Bowling Green State University (BGSU) to manufacture and install a new LED video display at Doyt Perry Stadium in Bowling Green, Ohio.
articles.title: Bowling Green State University Set to Unveil New Daktronics Display at Doyt Perry Stadium

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, has manufactured and installed an LED video board in the outfield of Field of Dreams Ballpark in Dyersville, Iowa.
articles.title: Field of Dreams Ballpark Gets Digital Feature with Daktronics LED Display

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) recently concluded its 2026 High School Video Summit, bringing together educators, production professionals and students for two days of learning, collaboration and real-world insight focused on live event production.
articles.title: Daktronics High School Video Summit Brings Educators, Students and Industry Professionals Together for Annual Learning Experience
